description: Bosses (V2_SPEC §4.7, P-67). Stats are at level 1 and scale with the creep rules. A boss has two phases: the second begins at atPct % of its HP, with its line, a speed change and its own moves. Every 'telegraphEvery'-th of its moves is the phase's telegraphed move, which takes two of its turns (announced, then landed), so it comes every telegraphEvery + 1 rounds. Guarding a telegraphed blow puts 'onGuardedTelegraph' on the boss, with its line; while a telegraph is pending the battle shows its 'warning' ({move}: the move's name) and Guard's 'guardDetail', which teach it (P-67). The reward is boss Shards (balance.json bossShardsMultiplier) plus 'item', or Shards of one creep of 'fallbackLevel' if the item is already owned or the bag is full (P-65). Only the engine sets 'defeatFlag'.

phases.line: The Herald's mantle splits. Beneath the ash, something is burning.
